newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daelim Ind signs $450 mln Indonesia deal.
newsitem.headline: Daelim Ind signs $450 mln Indonesia deal.

text.p: South Korea's Daelim Industrial Co said on Wednesday it had signed a $450 million contract with two Indonesian companies to build four thermoelectric power plants on a turn-key basis.
The contract was signed with PT Tenaga Listrick Sibolga and PT Tenaga Listrick Amurang, a Daelim spokesman said.

Daelim, which is engaged in petrochemical production and construction, will build two plants -- one with the capacity for 100 megawatts and the other for 55 megawatts -- each in Sibolga and Amurang, he said.
Construction is scheduled to start in January 1997 with completion due by September 1999, he added.
